item.description: - AI cleanup is now on by default, and Settings → Output → Cleanup is down to three simple controls. After a few dictations, or the first time you dictate a list or an email, Home offers a one-click download of the cleanup model. - Double-tapping the dictation key no longer makes the bubble pop up, vanish and reappear. A quick double-tap now locks hands-free dictation on the same take. - Clicking Download on the cleanup model twice, or leaving Home mid-download, no longer starts a second 1 GB download or shows a false error after a good install. - Invite links now send friends straight to the free download.

- Transcripts of imported audio and video files can now include timestamps. Turn on Settings → Output → Imported files → Include timestamps, and each line starts with its time range in the recording. It's off by default, and dictation is unchanged.

- Numbers → Prefer digits now covers spoken times ("ten thirty" → 10:30), years ("twenty twenty five" → 2025), phone-number digit runs, "a hundred people" → 100 people, "fifteen hundred" → 1500, and date ordinals ("the twenty-first of October" → the 21st of October). Smart is unchanged. - Live dictation captions expand correctly instead of appearing cropped inside a small black box. Larger text also keeps the Stop and Cancel buttons visible. - Dictionary sound-alike matching catches more split brand names, such as "ads viser" for "Adzviser". Taught spellings also tolerate spacing changes. - Add dictionary words in bulk: paste a list or two spreadsheet columns, review the spellings and optional mishearings, and save them together. Existing corrections are kept and duplicate entries are skipped.
